name: bpp-higher-a-sparse
description: qou-gcmn ANSWERED. B_pp per bond on pure-proton chains: 2.128360946 (A=2, reproducing the committed value by a different evaluator), 1.966342608 (A=3), 1.851585614 (A=4) MeV — a monotone 13.0% decline, against an A-independent chain bond of 2.050709692. So B_pp is NOT A-independent, the confound is real and signed, and the measured kappa decline OVERSTATES the EM-linking invariant. The companion probe's first disjunction branch is withdrawn. Also: the H_2A trace was never intractable — the sparse Hoefsmit multiply does A=4 (n=12, max dim 297) in ~50s where the dense evaluator does not return in 600s. Scope (a); the series is NOT corrected past A=4, which would be a fit.

assertions.name: method validated against the committed number, by a DIFFERENT path
assertions.detail: agrees to <1e-10. Different evaluator (sparse Schur-Weyl vs dense chi_lambda_numerical) and different crossings entry point (atom_canonical_crossings vs atomic_braid_to_crossings). Two independent routes to the committed B_pp_strong_MeV.

assertions.name: B_pp is NOT A-independent — monotone decline on all three points
assertions.detail: 2.128 -> 1.966 -> 1.852 MeV, a 13.0 % drop by A=4, against a chain bond frozen at 2.0507 for every A. The companion probe's FIRST disjunction branch (trace bond also A-independent) is WITHDRAWN; the second is the true one.

assertions.name: the correction direction is established; the series is NOT corrected
assertions.detail: B_pp(2)/B_pp(3) = 1.0823958, B_pp(2)/B_pp(4) = 1.1494802 — both above 1 and growing, so the held-B_pp kappa understates the true kappa and overstates its decline. No extrapolation past A=4 is made.

assertions.name: the H_2A bond is computable — the intractability claim was stale
assertions.detail: A=4 completes in 51 s with the column-sparse Hoefsmit multiply (<=2 nonzeros per row, O(dim^2*nnz) instead of O(dim^3)), machinery that landed 2026-08-30 in colour_weighting_across_mixed_nuclei_probe. em_linking_invariant_scoping's 'the A>3 bonds live at H_2A, intractable' predates it.
